text.zh_CN: 全院平仓警报响了！夜盘外围市场急剧缩量下挫，维持担保比例（Margin Ratio）全线告急。顾言，你的融资多头已经跌破 130% 警戒线，离强制平仓只剩 60 秒！
text.en: Academy-wide margin sirens are blaring! Overnight liquidity collapsed and margin maintenance ratios are cratering across desks. Gu Yan, your leveraged book breached the 130% threshold. You have 60 seconds before liquidation!

text.zh_CN: 别平仓！这是洗盘！只要明天早盘一开盘，资金一定会回流反弹的！我现在就向学院申请借调备用流动性把保证金补上！只要熬过今晚，我一定能翻本！
text.en: Don't liquidate! This is a deliberate shakeout! The moment the morning bell rings, capital will rotate back in! I'm requesting emergency academy liquidity right now to wire collateral! If I just survive tonight, I will make it all back!

text.zh_CN: 七年前，‘远望旧基金’出事的那天夜里，走廊上的红灯和警报声也是这样。所有人都以为我是看错了周期……其实只要再给我三天，市场就会迎来一轮强劲反弹。
text.en: Seven years ago, the night the old Farview Fund collapsed, the red lights and alarms looked the same. Everyone thought I had misread the cycle... in fact, three more days would have brought a strong rebound.

text.zh_CN: 但我没能撑过那三天。因为我太自信，把每一分钱都加上了三倍杠杆。杠杆最危险的地方，不是放大亏损，而是剥夺了你在黎明前等待的时间。你想象一下：如果你的账户也收到保证金提醒，你打算怎么做？
text.en: But I didn't last those three days. I was too confident and leveraged every dollar three times over. The real danger of leverage isn't bigger losses; it's that it takes away the time you need to wait for dawn. Imagine your own account just got a margin call. What do you do?

text.zh_CN: 面对保证金警戒线的处置方案：
text.en: Action plan facing margin maintenance alert:

text.zh_CN: 主动斩仓高风险敞口，立刻降低财务杠杆，退出危险区。
text.en: Voluntarily slash vulnerable risk assets; derisk leverage immediately.

toast.zh_CN: 风控决断：主动减仓，解除杠杆警戒
toast.en: Risk Action: Deleveraged positions to safety

text.zh_CN: 追加防守备用金维持现有仓位，赌行情在次日迅速修复。
text.en: Wire reserve collateral to defend positions; bet on morning bounce.

toast.zh_CN: 风控决断：追加保证金，维持杠杆敞口
toast.en: Risk Action: Injected collateral to maintain leverage

text.zh_CN: 不补不减，相信波动率自然收敛，硬扛过强平线考验。
text.en: Neither wire nor sell; let volatility resolve and test the margin line.

toast.zh_CN: 风控决断：拒绝干预，硬扛保证金压力
toast.en: Risk Action: Held through margin pressure

text.zh_CN: 极其果断。虽然承认了账面亏损，但你拿回了主动权。市场永远不会给你体面退出的机会，除非你主动把刹车踩到底。
text.en: Decisive execution. Realizing a paper loss stings, but you reclaimed control. The market never grants a graceful exit unless you slam the brakes yourself.

text.zh_CN: 你可以补一次保证金，但你不能保证每次都有救命钱。永远警惕：不要用无辜的好钱，去拯救一笔已经证明失败的坏交易。
text.en: You can wire collateral once, but you won't always have a lifeline. Beware the fatal sin: never throw good money after a structurally broken trade.

text.zh_CN: 靠侥幸撑过去，通常是清盘的前奏。把命运交给自动强平，在职业交易大厅里，这等于把主动权交出去。
text.en: Counting on luck is usually the prelude to liquidation. Leaving your fate to automatic forced selling is simply giving up control.

text.zh_CN: 检查你的维持担保比例。在金融世界里，杠杆不是不能用，但你必须随时清楚：最坏的一刀砍下来时，你能不能活命。
text.en: Audit your maintenance margin. Leverage isn't inherently evil, but you must answer at all times: when the worst-case axe drops, can you survive?
